mostWorthwhile.text: Connecting the loop was most worthwhile because it completed the water cycle and explained how the recovered moisture reaches the beds.

leastWorthwhile.text: Assembling the hose and pump was straightforward and offered no competing combination, though the resulting splash added an interesting detail.

surprise.text: I had not anticipated that the treated condensate would pass through a nutrient doser before joining the reservoir.

arbitrary.text: Neither action felt arbitrary: assembling the loop and connecting it to the garden port both served the stated goal.

continue.text: I would continue to see how the crops develop and how the expedition unfolds, although this chapter's two forced combinations offered little meaningful choice.
